deployments_detail.use: AI-driven software integrated into single-use endoscopy imaging platforms to improve diagnostic accuracy and reduce variability

EndoIntelligence — Ambu's proprietary digital/AI platform (formerly 'Digital Solutions & Systems') that powers its endoscopy portfolio across GI, pulmonology, ENT and urology, integrating software on the aBox 2 / aView 2 Advance units and adding AI for navigation, detection and documentation. Described by management as an increasingly significant differentiator and a core investment area. [Ambu (proprietary)]

Ambu Broncho Simulator — AI + augmented-reality bronchoscopy training system that uses a neural network to recognize anatomical locations in real time, overlays anatomical labels and a lung-tree diagram, and scores systematic navigation. Publicly launched/demonstrated (e.g., ATS 2026 booth) and validated in multiple published trials. [Ambu (proprietary neural network, using aScope 5 Broncho HD)]
deployments_detail.value: Trainees using the AI outperformed expert-tutor-trained peers: ~77s faster procedure time, ~7.9s faster intersegmental time, 7 fewer segment revisits (Agbontaen 2025)

deployments_detail.use: AI real-time guidance during clinical bronchoscopy — automatic bronchial segment identification neural network that ensures full, systematic inspection of the bronchial tree and documents completeness; positioned by researchers for clinical implementation beyond training. [Ambu (proprietary neural network)]

Next-generation AI-powered EndoIntelligence solutions — algorithm development and clinical validation for AI-driven detection/analysis in endoscopy (e.g. GI lesion detection); Ambu stood up a dedicated Clinical Data Acquisition function to generate the high-quality clinical data needed to train and validate these AI algorithms. [Ambu (proprietary)]

ARC (Advanced Red Contrast) — proprietary image-enhancement algorithm deployed in the aBox 2 / aView 2 Advance processing units (and scopes such as aScope 5 Cysto HD) that optimizes red wavelengths to heighten contrast between vascularized and non-vascularized tissue, aiding lesion/vascularity detection in real time during procedures. [Ambu (proprietary algorithm)]

AI-powered automated documentation within EndoIntelligence — advanced automated procedure documentation to reduce clinician administrative burden, announced as an expanded platform capability alongside AI navigation and detection. [Ambu (proprietary)]

Clinical Data Acquisition function — a newly established internal function running medical-device clinical studies specifically to acquire and manage high-quality clinical data for AI product innovation, algorithm development and clinical validation (distinct from traditional pharma trials). [Ambu (internal)]
